//: Project-wide Claude Code config, tracked so every contributor's agent starts from the same place.
Personal approvals belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored.
The allow list below is deliberately limited to commands that only READ, plus the build and test
commands an agent runs constantly. Anything that writes to the world -- git push, a deploy, a GM
command against the live server, killing a process -- is left to prompt, every time.
No deny list: state/ and logs/ are local-runtime output for a dev checkout (SQLite DB, stdout
captures), regenerated by running the server. Denying reads on them only made every `cd && grep`
unprovable and therefore a prompt, since an unresolvable read against any Read() deny rule must
ask. If this repo ever holds real player data, restore the deny rules and expect that friction.
